author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everyone.

So as you all know, it has come to conclusion that Referees will not be allowed to participate in the tourney. I will be saying my reasons as to why this is unfair and if you could hear me out, that would be great. Thanks.

First off, we only have 4 scrim servers so the most games that can go on at once if all the servers are used is 4 games. We have 30 referees and 6 officials at the moment. The matches I know will be hosted at a time that would be reasonable for most players. Given that, I would say that it is safe to say that there will be at least 20 referees/officials on at the moment that there is a match. Given that number and the maximum amount of matches that could be going on at 1 time, that would leave us with about 5 referees/officials per game. (That is with the bare minimum of referees/officials who would be online.) I'd say that a reasonable amount per match is 3 officials/ referees. (Probably 1 official and 2 referees) So if we multiply 3x4, that would equal to 12 people required if and only if 4 matches will be held at once. That is 12/36 referees/officials. Given that if there are going to be 20 referees/officials on at the time of any match, that means there would be 8 extras. Most of the referees are not in a team and are only reffing could fill in for those who may have a match going on. It has also come to my attention that some referees are still participating in the tourney while others cannot. So does this mean only a select few can participate in the tourney? It's either they can all play if they want or nobody that is a referee/official can participate. In the beginning when this tournament was in planning stages, I saw somewhere that said referees would be allowed to participate in the tournament. (Referee Applications Post)
https://avicus.net/forums/4f55e8409

It appears now there has been a change of plans. I'm just saying what I think about this situation and again, I will speak up for others. Thanks in advance.
